verdict.rationale: Goodwin's IP Litigation page describes "one of the most comprehensive trade secrets and employee mobility practices in the nation" and stresses time-sensitive trade secret cases. That covers the employee-mobility dispute and trade-secret litigation parts of the story. Its employment practice drafts restrictive covenant agreements, which supports protection work. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of confidentiality-program counseling, specific trade-secret matters or case examples, and independent corroboration beyond the firm's own practice pages.
